releaseNotes.summary: Project Library search, sorting and country filters; in-app Quick Log preview; laboratory Sample List with Batch Edit shortcut; streamlined QC summary and sidebar refinements.
releaseNotes.limitations: Development candidate only. Formal reviewer approvals and selective offline downloads are not active; full workflow testing is ongoing.
changes: Project library search, sorting, country/status filtering introduced in development.
Quick Log in-app factual preview and selected-investigation PDF access added for testing.
Laboratory Sample List and sample Batch Edit entry points introduced.
Log Review and QC summary navigation integrated into Data Review.
Desktop sidebar and release-notes presentation iterated; formal reviewer approvals remain under development.

releaseNotes.summary: Field workflow consistency improvements, batch-edit pagination, recovery QC override, Data Review layout and update handling improvements.
releaseNotes.limitations: Development candidate; live multi-device integration and full lifecycle QA incomplete.
changes: Expanded depth carry-forward and geological description reuse behaviours.
Added Batch Edit pagination and an explicit excessive-recovery QC exception path.
Introduced collapsible Data Review sections, desktop sidebar controls and update-notification revisions.
Development checks passed; live field and multi-device regression testing remains necessary.

releaseNotes.summary: Import exception handling for invalid source rows, earlier SPT/Point Load fixes, and Windows PWA icon updates.
releaseNotes.limitations: Controlled field candidate; additional QA and fixes identified.
changes: Added import exception handling: invalid source rows can be excluded with an exception report while valid records proceed.
Retained recovery, SPT and Point Load improvements from development candidates.
Updated Windows PWA icon assets and manifest references.
Released as a controlled production field candidate; later QA identified form and review issues.

releaseNotes.summary: In-situ form state fixes and missing-field geological inheritance on editing existing Point Load records.
releaseNotes.limitations: Candidate status; do not treat as an independently certified stable release.
changes: Fixed inconsistent in-situ SPT/Point Load form visibility when editing or changing test method.
Improved geological material and weathering inheritance for existing Point Load tests when fields are missing.
Preserved manually entered geological descriptions when editing.

releaseNotes.summary: Styled discontinuity follow-up, SPT running blow calculations and Point Load geological inheritance.
releaseNotes.limitations: Candidate version; later issues were addressed in subsequent builds.
changes: Replaced generic discontinuity follow-up with an in-app styled prompt.
Added automatic SPT N-value calculations with safeguards for partial penetration and override.
Introduced depth-based Point Load geological material/weathering inheritance.

releaseNotes.summary: Data workflow changes including Geotech forms, Batch Edit and Smart Merge groundwork.
releaseNotes.limitations: Not a production-approved release.
changes: Expanded Rock Mechanics Geotech logging and create/edit workflows.
Introduced or expanded spreadsheet-style Batch Edit and conservative Smart Merge workflows.
Reorganised data import, exports and Data Review entry points.
Development-only candidate; not signed off for production.

releaseNotes.summary: Established GitHub version-control baseline and field-tested structural logging.

changes: Preserved as the first GitHub-tagged stable baseline.
Enhanced field import/export and structural logging behaviour.
Field testing identified Geotech create/edit differences, motivating subsequent development.
